rulesTestNames: lets managers get a form's editor view and nothing else
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels form view triggers
read: current organizer managers get one form's view by id, as getOrganizerFormEditor admitted them (requireOrganizerManager); a view not written yet reads as missing; nobody lists the collection
write: server only; written from organizerForms and organizerFormDrafts and deleted when either is gone
migrationNotes: Replaces getOrganizerFormEditor for the Host app (#2306): the summary, draft definition and validation issues exactly as the callable returned them. Saves stay on updateOrganizerFormDraft, fenced by form.draftRevision; the editor waits for the view to reach the revision its own last save returned. The host-form-views copy-forward migration creates views for forms that predate the triggers.
The draft holds the organizer's own questions and copy, which every manager already edits; no respondent data.
